verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Import your mail' help article and a 'Move from Gmail' guide, and community users describe an easy built-in migration tool and smooth moves from Google, so importing mail history is evidenced. Importing contacts is not documented anywhere in the pack, and the import docs appear only as titles. missing for 10: evidence of contacts import, detail on whether the full mail history (all folders and archives) is imported, support for importing from desktop clients or files, in-depth first-party import documentation.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client

citations.quote: Fastmail has an easy migration tool if you don't want to go the IMAP route.
Was very pleasantly surprised how easy the move from Google services to Fastmail was
